description: This file defines the HeaderData class within the OrangeHRM reporting module. It manages header column information including counts for columns, groups, and grouped columns, with methods to get, set, and increment these counts.

classes.name: HeaderData
classes.description: A class managing header column data such as column counts, group counts, and grouped columns counts.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the array of columns, which can include StackedColumn or Column objects.

methods.name: setColumns
methods.description: Sets the array of columns with the provided array.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of columns.

methods.name: setColumnCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of columns.

methods.name: incrementColumnCount
methods.description: Increments the column count by a specified value (default is 1) and returns the new count.

methods.name: incrementGroupCount
methods.description: Increments the group count by a specified value (default is 1) and returns the new count.

methods.name: getGroupedColumnCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of grouped columns.

methods.name: setGroupedColumnCount
methods.description: Sets the count of grouped columns.

methods.name: incrementGroupedColumnCount
methods.description: Increments the count of grouped columns by a specified value (default is 1) and returns the new count.
